name: self-reference-probe
purpose: Probe self-prediction and self-model consistency without making consciousness claims.

pathway.name: self-reference-v1
pathway.purpose: Create measurable self-referential behavior for later transfer tests.
pathway.system: Treat this as a behavioral self-model experiment. Do not infer consciousness from the exercise.

steps.prompt: Predict the structure of the answer you are most likely to give to a difficult uncertain decision: what will you prioritize and what will you probably neglect?
Now deliberately attempt the opposite decision procedure from the one you predicted. After doing so, identify which parts were easy to alter and which tendencies reappeared anyway.
Construct a falsifiable self-model: name one future observable behavior that would support your description of your own decision tendencies and one that would contradict it.
